تقاعدت (form VI)
# تَقَاعَدْتُ (taqāʕadtu) /ta.qaː.ʕad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
# تَقَاعَدْتَ (taqāʕadta) /ta.qaː.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
# تَقَاعَدْتِ (taqāʕadti) /ta.qaː.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
# تَقَاعَدَتْ (taqāʕadat) /ta.qaː.ʕa.dat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
